notes.title: Netspectre at GameAccess '25
notes.notes: We're coming with the latest Netspectre build to GameAccess in Brno on the 6-7th June, so come say hi and play it if you'll be there as well! We'll be showcasing a lot of the new visuals and we're excited to hear what you think. And if you're still considering whether to come to GameAccess at all, definitely do! It's always great fun. See you there –

notes.title: Netspectre at GameAccess '24
notes.notes:
We're taking our latest Netspectre build to GameAccess in Brno next weekend (30/5-1/6), so come say hi and play it if you'll be around! The current build is perfectly playable from start to finish, so you can see whether you'll manage to beat it. Beware that we're not making it easy whatsoever! See you there –

notes.title: Netspectre at GameAccess '23
notes.notes:
This year's GameAccess in Brno is happening this week and we'll be there with Netspectre! We'll have a brand new build for you to play if you'll be around, so come say hi and check it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288799/02e0177a5604523a68ba5b4199437d8b618bb760.png[/img]

We'll be at the Indie Showcase zone all Friday and Saturday, i.e. the 2nd and 3rd June 2023. We have a lot of major updates freshly released for this build, such as a new UI or a new soundtrack, that we're curious what you think about. See you there!

[previewyoutube=YT_vLKpusaI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Netspectre at GDS '22 Indie Expo
notes.notes:
Game Developer Session '22 is taking place in Prague next Friday and Saturday, i.e. 23-24 September 2022, and we'll be there showcasing Netspectre in the Indie Expo zone! Come stop by to play our latest build for yourself, get a playtesting key, and just generally hang out and let us know what you think ^.^ From the lineup it seems there will be quite a few other cool indie games to check out, too!

See you there –

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288799/b6fcda8ac8e8e0210196751453d6fa8f614ddc27.png[/img]

notes.title: Netspectre talk at Cybertown '22
notes.notes:
Cybertown is this year's evolution of the Junkyard festival, which translates its concept of the large futuristic openair festival from the postapocalyptic theme to a more modern cyberpunk one: check it our here: [url=https://cybertown.cz][website][/url]! The schedule is packed with cool stuff all over the place for four days straight, so we're super curious and excited about what we'll see. 

We've been invited to give a talk about Netspectre in this year's talk & workshop track, so we'll be talking about how Netspectre came about and our most important design concepts. If you'll be around, stop by!

notes.title: Netspectre at Game Access '22 Indie Showcase
notes.notes:
We'd like to start inviting more people to play our current build, so that we can collect more feedback to guide us going forward. To that end, we signed up to present Netspectre in the Indie Showcase area of the Game Access conference on 27-28 May in Brno, so if you're attending, come say hi! 

We'll have a playable build of the game and we'll either guide you through it, or let you give it a go yourself, if you feel like hacking on your own ^.^

[url=https://i.imgur.com/cV50KbT.jpg][img]https://i.imgur.com/cV50KbT.jpg[/img][/url]

You can read more about GameAccess here:
[url=https://game-access.com/conference/indie-showcase/]https://game-access.com/conference/indie-showcase/[/url]

See you there!
